note: Initial test thresholds for the algorithm oracles. They bound agreement between two implementations; they are not a measured capability of any robot.

webots.note: Webots renders its LiDAR from a depth image: a beam may report its neighbour's range on a slanted surface (measured up to one beam). Agreement is within the ray-cast range over the beam and one neighbour each side, plus the tolerance; the median error must stay under lidarMedianM.

webotsArm.note: Initial test thresholds for the Webots arm plant, chosen from the X00 spike (docs/research/2026-11-webots-arm-spike.md): normal tracking error peaked at 0.0168 rad, settling took 2-3 ticks, a blocked arm exceeded 0.05 rad. They are not a measured capability of any arm.
